correctness.rationale: On smooth U the Ciani discriminant is (a²-1)(b²-1)(c²-1)(a²+b²+c²-abc-1). Quotient by the three sign involutions has elliptic quartic Hasse coefficient B proportional to ab+c, ac+b, bc+a; the Klein four isogeny has 2-primary kernel, thus preserves 3-divisible groups and the asserted 3-rank, a-number and Newton-slope decomposition. Pairwise intersections on U are punctured coordinate axes, common triple point the origin, with independent gradients. Summing q-field quadratic-character values over coefficients in F_q\{±1} counts smooth triples (q-2)^3-(q-3)^2; inclusion-exclusion on three divisor surfaces yields all four rank counts. Independently enumerated F3,F9,F27 arithmetic, obtaining r=3,2,1,0 counts respectively (1,0,0,0), (1,18,72,216), (1,72,1584,13392) as predicted. The all-q proof is the character sum, not finite extrapolation.
